title: Dump the L1 dispute system state
summary: Cast-driven read-only probe of the DisputeGameFactory + AnchorStateRegistry: every registered impl, init bond, and the last 5 games.
audience: Anyone debugging why a game isn't being created, or verifying the upgrade scripts actually changed state.
description:
Pure reads — no transactions. Useful as a sanity check before and after running an upgrade tool.

The Consensus panel renders the same data continuously; this script prints it as a single ASCII dump for copy-paste.

prerequisites.title: Playground running
prerequisites.detail: Needs OP_PG_DGF and OP_PG_PORTAL exposed — set automatically when launched via the playground binary.
